decisions.reason: Because this semi-hard cheese sits close to the firm's core cheese business and has already received launch and website support, management is likely to continue it and explain any weak performance as temporary rather than abandon the investment quickly.

As a multi-model spicy cheese line with visible presentation and strong fit to the firm's established cheese offer, it carries higher sunk commitment and is therefore the product management is most likely to persist with.

This soft cheese was explicitly introduced as part of the new offer and matches the firm's organic dairy identity, so escalation of commitment and the still favorable industry backdrop make continued support more likely than withdrawal.
